title: hippochaete praealta
intro: Hippochaete praealta, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the Northern Hemisphere. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as its ability to treat urinary tract infections and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Bearberry include its antiviral and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions like hemorrhoids and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Hippochaete praealta include arbutin, a glycoside responsible for its medicinal effects, as well as other phenolic compounds and flavonoids that contribute to its therapeutic actions.
